st: Pig heart transplants, and what we can learn from selling pet food online

sec.p: Le creature difuori guardavano dal maiale all'uomo e dall'uomo al maiale e ancora dal maiale all'uomo, ma già era loro impossibile distinguerefra i due. George Orwell,La Fattoria degli Animali

sec.t: ff.25.2 The scale of the transplant problem
sec.p: The main problem is that the number of transplant requests exceeds the available organs, which are in short, fortissimo short, supply.

Being able to communicate with (or at least interpret) the signals coming from other animals could matter in many ways: ensuring their well-being, understanding how much they suffer, or holding interesting philosophical discussions.

sec.t: ff.25.4 Amazon for pets: a bubble?
sec.p: Ryan Cohen is a very peculiar character. He reminds me a bit of Elon Musk, but at times he's even more of a living meme. Why are we talking about him? Because he made a fortune with animals.
